messages:
maria: Handoff from night shift — noticed a regen latency spike starting ~03:40 UTC on eu-west1. Error rates up ~3x for short queries, memory pressure on kv-proxy nodes.
jorge: Saw the same in dashboards. Started an incident #4512 and scaled kv-proxy pool by +3 nodes, cleared some evictions.
lee: Oncall-bot reported repeated kvcache evictions tied to large batch of similarity requests from embed-workers. I throttled the embed-ingest job to reduce churn.
sam: Thanks — I pushed a temporary autoscaler tweak to raise min replicas for kv-proxy in eu-west1 (patch in infra repo: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pull/1123). Keep an eye on error budget.
maria: Current status: latency decreased from p95 1.2s -> 700ms after scale + throttle, but p99 still elevated. No customer-facing alerts yet. Blocker: unsure if eviction pattern was due to a single noisy customer or a config regression.
jorge: I'm investigating recent deploys, looks like a model rollout to v2-quantized happened ~03:30. Canary logs show increased mem usage on host gh-04.
lee: Could we fallback those canary requests to older model variant while we debug? I can flip routing rule to prefer v1 for 10m.
sam: Go for it. I've prepared a quick rollback plan: update routing policy to pin to v1 for tenant:embed-heavy, and revert autoscaler tweak after steady state. I'll apply in 2 mins.
oncall-bot: Incident #4512 created. Severity: S2. Pager duty notified. Runbook: kvcache-eviction -> scale -> throttle -> rollback canary.
maria: Actions for next shift: 1) monitor p99 for next 30m; 2) keep embed-ingest throttled until we confirm model variant is stable; 3) if p99 > 1s for 10m, escalate to infra and ML infra (ping @ml-infra). I'll hand off to @jorge for follow-ups.
jorge: I'll watch logs and pull heapdumps if necessary. Also will check if canary rollout config included new kv proxy mem settings.
lee: I'll leave a small note on the infra PR and ping the author for context. If we need more capacity I'll pre-approve a +2 node bump.
sam: No other blockers from infra side. Leaving the rollback toggle with @maria to flip if false positives appear.
maria: Great — wrapping up. Final note: update the incident thread with any customer-facing notes before 04:30 UTC. TL;DR: scale + throttle mitigated, canary likely culprit, watch p99 and prepare rollback. :thumbsup:
